name: Nexwar
summary:
Nexwar is a browser-based fantasy PvP action RPG focused on skill-based combat, character progression and competitive multiplayer gameplay.

Fight other players in fast-paced encounters featuring directional combat, parry mechanics, equipment systems and customizable builds. Develop your character through gear, stats and progression while mastering timing and combat mechanics.

Currently in active development, Nexwar is continuously evolving with new gameplay systems, visual improvements and multiplayer content.
